results.title: NLC India AGM 2026: ₹3.85 FY26 Dividend, 11 Resolutions Pass
results.description: NLC India shareholders passed all 11 resolutions at the 70th AGM, including the ₹0.25 final dividend and a renewable asset transfer. See the vote results.

results.title: Ayodhya’s 14-Kosi Parikrama Route Gets Major Makeover Ahead of Deepotsav
results.description: Ayodhya’s 14-kosi parikrama route is nearing completion of a Rs 1,140-crore upgrade, with four-laning, lighting, sanitation, seating and water facilities planned ahead of Deepotsav.
